summary: F5 confirms phishing mail delivered from docusign-aegean-share.com with subject "Satın alma sözleşmesi – imza bekliyor". F2 and F3 confirm session-token replay via zero-MFA sign-ins from OVH SAS (AS16276) while the user was concurrently active on managed device dev-zk-01. F4 confirms a DigitalOcean Netherlands sign-in outside baseline. F1 confirms impossible travel Amsterdam to Gravelines in 15 minutes. Verdict: contain at 0.9 confidence.

contrastive.explanation: Removing F2, F3 would drop the chain below the "≥2 confirmed abuse OR 1 abuse + 2 access" threshold, so the policy would escalate for human review.

risk.rationale: Verified findings show a phishing-suspect message delivered to the user (F5) followed by zero-MFA session-token/sign-in activity from OVH AS16276 with no managed device while the same account is concurrently active on the university-managed device (F2, F3). That is corroborated by impossible travel Amsterdam→Gravelines in 15 minutes (F1) and an additional suspicious DigitalOcean NL sign-in outside baseline (F4). Together these form a confirmed account-takeover chain rather than explainable noise; the rejected password-spray claim does not account for concurrent legitimate and external session reuse. Immediate containment is warranted.
